text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make software easier to understand and maintain. When developers refactor, they clean up messy sections, remove duplicate code, and give variables clearer names. This greatly improves readability, so other programmers can quickly understand the logic. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes are used instead of proper solutions. By regularly refactoring, teams keep their projects healthy and avoid bigger problems in the future. It is an essential practice for any serious software development project.
